package net.runelite.client.plugins.microbot.kspaiofighter;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.Predicate;
import net.runelite.api.Client;
import net.runelite.client.plugins.microbot.Microbot;
import net.runelite.client.plugins.microbot.util.bank.Rs2Bank;
import net.runelite.client.plugins.microbot.util.inventory.Rs2Inventory;
import net.runelite.client.plugins.microbot.util.inventory.Rs2ItemModel;
import org.mockito.MockedStatic;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.*;

/** Copy outside the repository as .java; keep test dependencies out of Source Loader. */
public final class KspAioFighterInventoryLoaderTest
{
    private static final int KEY = 983, SHARK = 385, NOTED_SHARK = 386;
    private static void check(boolean condition, String message) {
        if (!condition) throw new AssertionError(message);
    }
    private static String name(int id) { return id == KEY ? "Brass key" : "Shark"; }
    private static KspAioFighterInventoryItem item(int id, int quantity) {
        return new KspAioFighterInventoryItem(id, quantity, 0, name(id), id == NOTED_SHARK);
    }
    private static void scenario(String label, List<KspAioFighterInventoryItem> setup,
            Map<Integer, Integer> carried, Map<String, Integer> stored,
            boolean expected, boolean depositSucceeds) throws Exception
    {
        Map<Integer, Integer> inventory = new LinkedHashMap<>(carried);
        Map<String, Integer> stock = new HashMap<>(stored);
        boolean[] notedMode = {false};
        int[] deposits = {0}, withdrawals = {0};
        KspAioFighterInventorySettings settings = mock(KspAioFighterInventorySettings.class);
        when(settings.isEnabled(KspAioFighterGearStyle.STRENGTH)).thenReturn(true);
        when(settings.get(KspAioFighterGearStyle.STRENGTH)).thenReturn(setup);
        KspAioFighterInventoryLoader loader = new KspAioFighterInventoryLoader(mock(KspAioFighterConfig.class), settings);
        try (MockedStatic<Microbot> microbot = mockStatic(Microbot.class);
             MockedStatic<Rs2Bank> bank = mockStatic(Rs2Bank.class);
             MockedStatic<Rs2Inventory> inv = mockStatic(Rs2Inventory.class))
        {
            microbot.when(Microbot::isLoggedIn).thenReturn(true);
            microbot.when(Microbot::getClient).thenReturn(mock(Client.class));
            bank.when(Rs2Bank::walkToBankAndUseBank).thenReturn(true);
            bank.when(() -> Rs2Bank.count(anyString(), eq(true))).thenAnswer(call -> stock.getOrDefault(call.getArgument(0), 0));
            inv.when(Rs2Inventory::isEmpty).thenAnswer(call -> inventory.isEmpty());
            inv.when(() -> Rs2Inventory.itemQuantity(anyString(), eq(true))).thenAnswer(call ->
                inventory.entrySet().stream().filter(e -> name(e.getKey()).equalsIgnoreCase(call.getArgument(0)))
                    .mapToInt(Map.Entry::getValue).sum());
            inv.when(() -> Rs2Inventory.getList(any(Predicate.class))).thenAnswer(call -> {
                List<Rs2ItemModel> models = new ArrayList<>();
                for (Map.Entry<Integer, Integer> entry : inventory.entrySet()) {
                    Rs2ItemModel model = mock(Rs2ItemModel.class);
                    when(model.getId()).thenReturn(entry.getKey());
                    when(model.getQuantity()).thenReturn(entry.getValue());
                    models.add(model);
                }
                return models;
            });
            bank.when(Rs2Bank::depositAll).thenAnswer(call -> {
                deposits[0]++;
                if (!depositSucceeds) return false;
                inventory.forEach((id, quantity) -> stock.merge(name(id), quantity, Integer::sum));
                inventory.clear();
                return true;
            });
            bank.when(Rs2Bank::setWithdrawAsItem).thenAnswer(call -> { notedMode[0] = false; return true; });
            bank.when(() -> Rs2Bank.setWithdrawAs(true)).thenAnswer(call -> { notedMode[0] = true; return true; });
            bank.when(() -> Rs2Bank.withdrawX(eq(true), anyString(), anyInt(), eq(true))).thenAnswer(call -> {
                String wanted = call.getArgument(1);
                int quantity = call.getArgument(2);
                check(stock.getOrDefault(wanted, 0) >= quantity, "cannot overdraw: " + label);
                stock.merge(wanted, -quantity, Integer::sum);
                int id = wanted.equals("Brass key") ? KEY : notedMode[0] ? NOTED_SHARK : SHARK;
                inventory.merge(id, quantity, Integer::sum);
                withdrawals[0]++;
                return true;
            });
            check(loader.load(KspAioFighterGearStyle.STRENGTH) == expected, label + ": " + loader.getLastError());
            if (!expected) {
                check(withdrawals[0] == 0, "failed validation/deposit must not withdraw: " + label);
                check(inventory.equals(carried), "failure must preserve carried items: " + label);
            }
            if (label.equals("already exact")) check(deposits[0] == 0 && withdrawals[0] == 0, "exact setup needs no banking");
            if (label.equals("empty inventory")) check(deposits[0] == 0, "do not deposit an empty inventory");
        }
        System.out.println("PASS: " + label);
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception
    {
        scenario("carried brass key absent from bank", List.of(item(KEY, 1), item(SHARK, 3)), Map.of(KEY, 1), Map.of("Shark", 3), true, true);
        scenario("partial stack plus bank stock", List.of(item(SHARK, 5)), Map.of(SHARK, 2), Map.of("Shark", 3), true, true);
        scenario("genuinely insufficient combined stock", List.of(item(SHARK, 5)), Map.of(SHARK, 2), Map.of("Shark", 2), false, true);
        scenario("noted inventory can supply unnoted setup", List.of(item(SHARK, 3)), Map.of(NOTED_SHARK, 3), Map.of(), true, true);
        scenario("combined noted and unnoted demand", List.of(item(SHARK, 2), item(NOTED_SHARK, 3)), Map.of(), Map.of("Shark", 4), false, true);
        scenario("enough stock for both forms", List.of(item(SHARK, 2), item(NOTED_SHARK, 3)), Map.of(), Map.of("Shark", 5), true, true);
        scenario("already exact", List.of(item(KEY, 1)), Map.of(KEY, 1), Map.of(), true, true);
        scenario("empty inventory", List.of(item(KEY, 1)), Map.of(), Map.of("Brass key", 1), true, true);
        scenario("deposit failure", List.of(item(KEY, 1), item(SHARK, 3)), Map.of(KEY, 1), Map.of("Shark", 3), false, false);
    }
}
